title: RegisterDevice
description: supabase/functions/register-device/index.ts. Authenticated (JWT required) — called immediately after every successful sign-in/sign-up. Idempotent: if the caller's profile already has this exact device_id_hash, returns {status:"ok"} with no write. Paid users (plan != free) can register any device_hash freely (no lock). Free-tier users are blocked with 409 device_already_registered if another free-tier profile already owns this device_hash. AccountService.swift signs the user back out on a 409 with this specific error string.

error.title: RegisterDeviceErrorCode
error.description: device_already_registered is returned with HTTP 409, not the usual 400/401/402/429 pattern used elsewhere.
